capability.exactly_one: Select an evidence value span corresponding to the requested key from a short actual observation, and preserve source attribution

hypotheses.h1: Choice depends on requested-key-to-observed-record relation; both members of valid changed-value pairs have correct evidence and copied value
hypotheses.h0: Selection fails or follows constant position, memorized value, format shortcut, or a leaked target label

candidate.generation_policy: Enumerate every eligible observation value, without filtering to the requested key

proposed_gates.required: Only existing private report: verify aggregate identity and six signed context-benefit differences
Provenance groups and prospective context-benefit design; keep holdout isolated
Choose model/tokenizer/serializer/eligible pairs/primary endpoint/budget and freeze before scoring
Verify candidate completeness, oracle and position controls, UTF-8 spans, token limits and no label leakage
Bounded model-only one-step CPU trial on predeclared paired worlds; append all failures

metrics.reference_control: Rule-based key lookup, explicitly not a learned Aster ability
metrics.unit_of_independence: task/template/source family, not generated variants or seeds

guardrails: Do not modify old model, tokenizer, serializer or data splits while diagnosing
Do not open sealed test or private records via public repository
Keep answer labels in verifier-only sidecar
Leave old run and artifact immutable; append a new cycle for changes
Code/CI pass does not establish capability
No model training or metric is authorized by this proposal
next_question: After LANG #113 and READ preflight: does the fixed model choose evidence correctly in both paired worlds, or does it exploit a shortcut?
